agent.architectureSub: Full interactive mode — use the toolbar (Theme / Style / Present / Export), PATH·MAP·LENS controls, hover and click components to explore the system architecture and details
agent.eightCapabilitiesSub: Concrete implementation of Reliable, Controlled and Auditable

pillars.title: Reliable
points: Deterministic state machine constrains the action sequence — no skipping steps
Idempotent retries + failure compensation — no duplicate authorization on re-execution
Triple budget on steps / tokens / time — terminates immediately when the cap is hit
Only delivered after convergence check done:true passes

pillars.title: Controlled
points: IAM least privilege + physical multi-tenant isolation
Tool allowlist registry — unregistered tools are rejected outright
Strongly-typed parameter validation + sensitive data masking
High-risk actions are handed back for human HITL approval

pillars.title: Auditable
points: Full-chain Trace replay — every single step accounted for
Model / prompt versions recorded on every run
State transitions and tool calls persisted one by one
Success rate / latency / cost / human takeover rate visualized
